title: Time Travel
synopsis: Merging main into an old branch tricked the earlier-work cutoff into erasing the branch's own edits; Kit makes the cutoff only look at work from before the branch.
altText: Panel 1: Sam merges main into PR #1 and Tracetoon now says only 4% of it was the agent's. Panel 2: Kit sees that later PRs from main pushed the cutoff past PR #1's edits. Panel 3: Glitch rides a time machine labeled 'merge main'. Panel 4: Kit only counts base work from before the branch began; Sam cheers at the restored numbers.

panels.scene: Sam is surprised by a 4% match after merging main into PR #1

dialogue.speaker: caption
dialogue.text: Main now held later PRs, made after this branch's work.

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: So the cutoff jumped past our own edits.

panels.scene: Glitch rides a time machine labeled merge main
Kit shows the fix and Sam cheers

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: Only work from before the branch counts now.

dialogue.speaker: sam
dialogue.text: And PR #1 is back to normal!
